title: ROI ASIC: staged fleet baseline and rollback gates
description:
https://roiasic.com/enterprise/

A factual walkthrough of the ROI ASIC staged fleet method: one representative device, a 24-hour comparison, bounded waves and rollback gates. The method is an operational template, not a performance, savings or profitability forecast.

Evidence record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21992166
